```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .dt-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .dt-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .dt-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .dt-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .dt-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .dt-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    background: #F8F7F0;
  }

  .dt-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .dt-card:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .dt-card:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }
  .dt-card:hover .dt-card-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  .dt-card-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .dt-card-icon {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .dt-card-icon svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .dt-card-titles {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .dt-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .dt-sublabel {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9896CC;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .dt-desc {
    font-size: 0.88em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  .dt-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #5654A2;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    border: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 1px 6px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .dt-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .dt-card { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; padding: 14px; }
    .dt-card:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  }
</style>

<div class="dt-outer">
  <div class="dt-header">
    <div class="dt-header-icon"><i data-lucide="folder-tree"></i></div>
    <span class="dt-header-text">Claude Code Directory Types</span>
  </div>
  <div class="dt-grid">
    <div class="dt-card">
      <div class="dt-card-top">
        <div class="dt-card-icon"><i data-lucide="home"></i></div>
        <div class="dt-card-titles">
          <div class="dt-label">Home Directory</div>
          <div class="dt-sublabel">~ (global)</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="dt-desc">
        <span class="dt-tag">CLAUDE.md</span> here applies to all projects globally.
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dt-card">
      <div class="dt-card-top">
        <div class="dt-card-icon"><i data-lucide="folder-open"></i></div>
        <div class="dt-card-titles">
          <div class="dt-label">Project Directory</div>
          <div class="dt-sublabel">cd project/ (scoped)</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="dt-desc">
        <span class="dt-tag">CLAUDE.md</span> here applies only to this project.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
